title: Pure Madoor
summary: Pure Madoor high-DEF Spellcaster wall and stat-inversion build, backed by generic Normal Monster support and Spellcaster staples. The strategy leverages the massive DEF of Aqua Madoor and Neo Aqua Madoor, flipping their defensive stats into 3000 ATK beatsticks with Shield & Sword and Inverse Universe.

summary.title: Starters
points: Unexpected Dai Special Summons Aqua Madoor directly from the Deck while you control no monsters, putting a Spellcaster on the field for Crowley, the First Propheseer.
Rescue Rabbit banishes itself to Special Summon two copies of Aqua Madoor from the Deck for Rank 4 Xyz or Link plays.

summary.title: Opening: Rescue Rabbit + Crowley
steps: Normal Summon Rescue Rabbit and banish it to Special Summon two copies of Aqua Madoor from your Deck.
Link Summon Crowley, the First Propheseer using both Aqua Madoors.
Use Crowley's continuous effect to Normal Summon Neo Aqua Madoor from your hand without Tributing.

Pass turn with a 3000 DEF wall holding the board, with Shield & Sword or Inverse Universe ready to turn the Madoors into 3000 ATK attackers. (Secret Village of the Spellcasters, the old Spell lock, is Forbidden since October 2026.)

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Crowley, the First Propheseer allows you to Normal Summon a Level 5 or higher Spellcaster like Neo Aqua Madoor without Tributing.

Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians accumulates Spell Counters from Spells on field and in GYs, removing three counters as a Quick Effect to revive a Spellcaster like Neo Aqua Madoor or Lightray Madoor from the GY in Defense Position.
Performage Trapeze Magician prevents you from taking damage if the amount is less than its ATK, and targets another monster to allow it to attack twice during each Battle Phase.
First of the Dragons is immune to all other monster effects and cannot be destroyed by battle except by a Normal Monster.
Mistar Boy boosts all WATER monsters by 500 ATK and DEF while recycling a WATER monster if destroyed.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Shield & Sword swaps the original ATK and DEF of all face-up monsters on the field until the End Phase, transforming Neo Aqua Madoor and Lightray Madoor into 3000 ATK attackers.
Inverse Universe permanently swaps the ATK and DEF of all face-up Effect Monsters on the field, granting Lightray Madoor a permanent 3000 ATK while crippling opposing high-ATK bosses.
Unexpected Dai and Rescue Rabbit provide immediate Deck access to Normal Monster Aqua Madoor without requiring Tributes.

allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons Level 4 Normal Monster Aqua Madoor directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
allow.Rescue Rabbit: Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of Aqua Madoor from your Deck for an instant Rank 4 Xyz or Link-2 play.
allow.Shield & Sword: Swaps the original ATK and DEF of all face-up monsters on the field until the End Phase, turning 2000 DEF Aqua Madoor and 3000 DEF Neo Aqua Madoor / Lightray Madoor into massive beatsticks.
allow.Inverse Universe: Normal Trap that permanently swaps the ATK and DEF of all face-up Effect Monsters on the field (giving Lightray Madoor a permanent 3000 ATK!).
allow.Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians: Link-3 Spellcaster that gains Spell Counters and revives Neo Aqua Madoor or Lightray Madoor from your GY in Defense Position during either player's Main Phase.
allow.Crowley, the First Propheseer: Link-2 Spellcaster made with two Madoor Spellcasters that allows you to Normal Summon Level 5+ Spellcasters (Neo Aqua Madoor) without Tributing!
allow.Eria the Water Charmer, Gentle: Link-2 WATER Spellcaster summoned using Aqua Madoor that steals a WATER monster from your opponent's GY and searches on destruction.
allow.Performage Trapeze Magician: Rank 4 Spellcaster Xyz made with two Level 4 Spellcasters (Aqua Madoors) that grants an extra attack and prevents effect damage.
allow.First of the Dragons: Fusion tower immune to all monster effects and indestructible by battle except with Normal Monsters.
allow.Quintet Magician: 4500 ATK Spellcaster boss that board-wipes all cards the opponent controls on summon.

main: Classic Level 4 WATER Spellcaster Normal Monster (1200 ATK / 2000 DEF): summoned from the Deck via Unexpected Dai and Rescue Rabbit to enable Crowley and Spellcaster Xyz plays.
Level 6 WATER Spellcaster Normal Monster (1200 ATK / 3000 DEF): can be Normal Summoned with 0 Tributes via Crowley, the First Propheseer and reaches 3000 ATK under Shield & Sword.

Level 6 LIGHT Spellcaster Effect Monster (1200 ATK / 3000 DEF): Special Summons itself from your hand when 3 or more of your LIGHT monsters are banished, cannot be destroyed by battle once per turn, and becomes a 3000 ATK attacker under Inverse Universe or Shield & Sword.
Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of Aqua Madoor directly from your Deck.

Permanently swaps the ATK and DEF of all face-up Effect Monsters on the field, giving Lightray Madoor 3000 ATK and punishing high-ATK opposing bosses.
